title: The Lord of the Rings: Journeys in Middle-earth
subtitle: App-supported cooperative adventure across the iconic landscapes of Tolkien's Middle-earth
tagline: Form your Fellowship and fight the encroaching shadow across the wilds of Middle-earth
loreSummary: Dark omens gather across Eriador as ancient evils stir in ruined fortresses and shadowy forests. Guided by a companion app, your band of heroes must scout forgotten lands, battle Orcs and fell beasts, and uncover the secret terror rising in the North.
keyFeatures: Companion app driving narrative events, procedural maps, and reactive enemy AI
Dual-mode gameplay alternating between vast hex exploration maps and tactical grid battle mats
Deck-crafting skill test system replacing dice for streamlined, strategic resolution
Branching campaign narrative where triumphs and setbacks dynamically shape the journey
